title: saxifraga stellaris subsp. engleri
intro: Saxifraga stellaris subsp. engleri, commonly known as the Star Saxifrage, is a plant species that belongs to the Saxifragaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, primarily due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which contribute to its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Saxifraga stellaris subsp. engleri include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as antimicrobial and immunomodulatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
